params.name: branch
params.description: Key of a long lived branch

params.name: category
params.description: Event category. Filter analyses that have at least one event of the category specified.

params.name: from
params.description: Filter analyses created after the given date (inclusive). Either a date (server timezone) or datetime can be provided

params.name: ps
params.description: Page size. Must be greater than 0 and less or equal than 500

params.name: to
params.description: Filter analyses created before the given date (inclusive). Either a date (server timezone) or datetime can be provided
